openssl 3.5.5 (one pinned source for both platforms)

windows-x64: openssl 3.5.5 built from pinned source (openssl-3.5.5 tag,
        commit 67b5686b4419b4cb8caa502711c41815f5279751; annotated tag
        85a9a2ee19845d6a68a2c68255271068935f57f4).
        Build 2026-11-07 in MSYS2 (msys2.exe mingw64 environment; gcc 16.2.0
        Rev6 built by MSYS2 project, perl 5.42.3, GNU make 4.4.1; configure
        `./Configure mingw64 no-tests no-apps -O3`, repository clone at C:\ossl).
        No MSYS2 distribution ships in any package; the toolchain is the
        local build host only. The superseded mingw-w64-x86_64-openssl-3.5.4-1
        package checksums are retained in ossl-3.5.4-package.sha256 for the
        audit trail.
openssl-headers: carried over from the linux 3.5.5 build; identical
        source for both platforms (headers are platform-independent).
linux-x64: openssl 3.5.5 built from pinned source (openssl-3.5.5 tag,
        commit 67b5686b4419b4cb8caa502711c41815f5279751, build 2026-11-07
        WSL2 Ubuntu, gcc 15.2.0, configure linux-x86_64 no-shared no-tests no-apps)
linux-arm64: NOT BUILT in v0.2 (no archives; the native row compiles the TLS
        stub, which fails closed with ERR_TLS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE).
release: v0.2.0 (first TLS-enabled release).
Source tag: https://github.com/openssl/openssl (openssl-3.5.5)
CA bundle: Mozilla, third_party/openssl/cacert.pem (see cacert-source-url.txt),
embedded into TLS-linked binaries at compile time (no runtime file lookup,
no source-tree dependency).
